editorial.blurb: This lively Indian spot dishes out homemade, authentic flavors—from crispy pakora to silky salmon tikka masala—with warm, attentive service.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the salmon tikka masala with garlic naan (or butter naan if you prefer less garlic), and grab a mango lassi on the house if you're a first-time visitor—the portions are small but refreshing.
